Version, connected outlet & unit, HDMI input, mode, and permissions

NEW TV SETUP (once)
1. Choose HDMI input → the port the PlayStation is plugged into.
2. HDMI display mode → Inside the app. If the PS picture does not appear, switch to Switch TV input.
3. Display over other apps → allow it for NEXBILL TV.
4. Make it the TV's main app → choose NEXBILL TV.
5. Screen guard → On.
6. Test: Open the game screen for 10 minutes, check picture, sound & controllers, then End staff mode.

DAILY USE (press OK or MENU on the remote → cashier PIN)
• Start session: choose a package, duration, or Open. The game screen opens and the timer runs.
• Add time: for timed sessions.
• End session now: the timer stops, the screen locks, and the bill goes to the Cashier (Open Orders).
• Sync status: actions from the TV not yet/failed to reach the dashboard. When the internet is down everything keeps working and is sent automatically once online.
